sinopsis.es: Para enfrentar el dolor por la muerte de su madre, Stefan vuelve a su pueblo natal. Quiere terminar un documental inconcluso sobre ella, una mujer libre y carismática, e involucra a su familia. En el camino atropella a un perro, y la pérdida se intensifica. Entre archivo y puesta en escena, un retrato íntimo y melancólico del amor y el duelo.
sinopsis.en: To confront the pain of his mother's death, Stefan returns to his hometown. He wants to finish an incomplete documentary about her, a free-spirited and charismatic woman, and involves his family. On the way he runs over a dog, and the loss intensifies. Between footage and staging, an intimate, melancholic portrait of love and grief.
